package.signatureStatus: unsigned pkg; app bundle ad-hoc signed

execution.method: Ran the packaged app bundle executable with --user-data-dir against an isolated APFS clone; the PKG payload app.asar hash matches the runtime app.asar.

conclusion: The six deterministic payload-shape failures and 16 sessions with no History source were not retried after restart. Twelve coverage-mismatch sessions with retained History stream/event evidence remained retryable. Adding History to a session parked for having no History source advances source_revision and the regression test confirms the backfill completes.
limitations: No trusted window click, session-switch timing, or Long Task/LoAF measurement was collected.
The produced PKG was expanded for payload hash verification but not installed; the app bundle with identical app.asar was run directly.
The PKG has no installer signature because no Developer ID Application identity is available.
